problem_context.problem_statement: Reverify CircularAreaWrite and its local callees against the single canonical CircularAreaBackingResource/CircularAreaLogicalState using option-valued mixed_full; make the public contract composable from CircularAreaInit and into CircularAreaRead without assuming uninitialized bytes are initialized.
problem_context.expected_behavior: For force=0, preserve error states and append exactly the actually written input prefix to the logical FIFO while updating one or two physical mixed slices and preserving all other cells. Model the production status bit as an equal-index full/empty discriminator. For force!=0, specify only behavior justified by the actual implementation and physical initialization state; do not claim unread initialized bytes that are absent.
problem_context.input_output_contract: All real CRTOS call sites use force=0 and must be able to call Write on the resource returned by Init; EOK=0 and ERROR=1. Successful output must establish the same canonical resource consumed by Read/DataLength/Release.
spec_hint: Use direct Require Export of QCIPLib.xizi.xizi_circular_area_common.xizi_circular_area_lib; define extensional logical/physical ring-update relations in the case lib rather than mirroring C control flow.
preferred_hidden_properties: The actual non-force write length is min(requested, capacity - Zlength logical), and logical_after is logical ++ sublist 0 actual input.
Only written ring positions change from the old option-valued physical list to Some input bytes; untouched positions retain their old None/Some values.
b_status may be 0 or 1 when indices differ; equal indices plus status distinguish empty from full.
forbidden_patterns: Do not replace mixed_full with UCharArray.full or invent values for None cells.
Do not weaken CircularAreaLiveBytes or the canonical shared resource merely to accommodate force mode.
Do not use the compatibility CircularAreaDescriptorState as the public Write state.
reference_case_hints: OUTPUT/xizi/xizi_circular_area_read and OUTPUT/xizi/xizi_circular_area_data_length are predicate-first style references; QCP_demos_human is forbidden.

annotation_contract.ready_condition: agent_result.annotation.status == completed and ready_for_annotation_check_round == true only after canonical QCP, case_lib coqc, and annotation-checking pass; self_reworkable_failures must be empty
annotation_contract.blocked_condition: only phase skill hard blockers should use status == blocked; self_repair_budget_exhausted is work evidence, not an automatic blocked condition

mathematical_postconditions_required: Function specs must state what result the function computes, not only bounds or shape facts.
Loop invariants must connect processed state to the final mathematical postcondition.
avoid_spec_antipatterns: Do not weaken the spec to shape-only or bounds-only conditions.
Do not restate the C loops as the mathematical definition.
